description: This file defines the VTWSEntityType class, which uses the web services API to reflect on various entity types within the vtiger CRM system. It includes methods for describing entity types, retrieving field information, and handling field types and labels.

classes.name: VTWSEntityType
classes.description: Implements reflection on vtiger entity types via web services API, providing methods to describe entities, fetch field metadata, label, type, and ID.

classes.name: VTWSFieldType
classes.description: Represents the type of a field, with a method to convert its properties into an array.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the VTWSEntityType object and fetches the description for the specified entity type.

methods.name: usingGlobalCurrentUser
methods.description: Creates an instance of VTWSEntityType for a given entity type using the current global user.

methods.name: forUser
methods.description: Creates an instance of VTWSEntityType for a given entity type and user.

methods.name: getTabId
methods.description: Retrieves the tab ID associated with the entity type from the database.

methods.name: getModuleName
methods.description: Returns the module name of the entity type.

methods.name: getFieldNames
methods.description: Returns a list of field names for the entity type.

methods.name: getFieldLabel
methods.description: Returns the label for a specific field.

methods.name: getFieldLabels
methods.description: Builds and returns a mapping of field names to labels.

methods.name: getFieldType
methods.description: Returns a VTWSFieldType object describing the type of a specific field.

methods.name: getFieldTypes
methods.description: Returns a mapping of field names to their respective VTWSFieldType objects.
